name: What factors affect the structural feasibility of adding a second story?

mainEntity.name: What factors affect the structural feasibility of adding a second story?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several factors determine the structural feasibility of a second-story addition. These include the existing foundation's condition and capacity, the integrity of the lower-level walls, and the overall structural design of your current home. Soil conditions, roof type, and the age of the house also play a role. A structural engineer will conduct a thorough assessment to ensure the property can safely support the added weight and construction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Structural feasibility depends on the existing foundation, lower-level walls, overall home design, soil conditions, and roof type.
